column1: # sdiff_pairs.h): which spatial order a pattern selects, and the partner map or
# reference sets it parses to, or its refusal.  Run by klustersshared_sdiff_pairs_test
# (C++), fiber-kit test/test_sdiff_grammar.py (fiber_stderiv) and, for the order
# ndm_sdiff_pattern_order).  Byte-identical copies in both repositories
# Columns (TAB-separated; a spec may carry spaces, never a TAB):
#   spec    one group's pattern, or a colon-separated list (the -P form)
#   order   what sdiffSpecOrder selects: 6 names a channel, else 5 with '+', else 4
#   pairs   parseSdiffPairs: the partner position per channel (the root wired to its
#           first predecessor), or ERR when refused; '-' for a spec not parsed here
#   sets    parseSdiffSets: one set per channel, members joined by '+', or ERR; '-' as above
